messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.48-1
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.48-1) has been released at its website (https://rqtl.org) and on CRAN. Windows and Mac binaries will be available on CRAN within a few days.

This fixes a bug in R/qtl in the case of QTL on the X chromosome; see https://github.com/kbroman/qtl/blob/master/NEWS.md

Karl Broman
